x = 3.923 * x * (1 - x)\n","\n","    barisan = np.zeros(banyak, dtype=np.int32)\n","\n","    for i in range(banyak):\n","\n","        x = 3.923 * x * (1 - x)\n","\n","        barisan[i] = int(x * 1000 % 256)\n","\n","    return barisan\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# KEY GENERATION\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def kunci(n, x0, ed='e'):\n","\n","    banyak = int(n * (n - 1) / 2)\n","\n","    barisan = logistic_map(\n","        x0,\n","        banyak + n - 1\n","    )\n","\n","    print(\"\\nSequence from logistic map:\")\n","    print(barisan)\n","\n","    msa = np.eye(n, dtype=np.int32)\n","\n","    indeks = 0\n","\n","    # upper triangular\n","    for i in range(n):\n","\n","        for j in range(i + 1, n):\n","\n","            msa[i, j] = barisan[indeks]\n","\n","            indeks += 1\n","\n","    print(\"\\nUpper triangular matrix:\")\n","    print(msa)\n","\n","    # lower triangular\n","    for baris_i in range(1, n):\n","\n","        msa[baris_i] = (\n","            r_ij(\n","                msa,\n","                baris_i,\n","                0,\n","                barisan[indeks]\n","            )\n","        ) % 256\n","\n","        indeks += 1\n","\n","    print(\"\\nFinal key matrix:\")\n","    print(msa)\n","\n","    # ========================================================\n","    # ENCRYPTION MODE\n","    # ========================================================\n","\n","    if ed == 'e':\n","\n","        return msa, 0\n","\n","    # ========================================================\n","    # DECRYPTION MODE\n","    # ========================================================\n","\n","    elif ed == 'd':\n","\n","        augmented = np.zeros(\n","            (n, 2 * n),\n","            dtype=np.int32\n","        )\n","\n","        augmented[:, :n] = msa\n","\n","        augmented[:, n:] = np.eye(\n","            n,\n","            dtype=np.int32\n","        )\n","\n","        print(\"\\nAugmented matrix:\")\n","        print(augmented)\n","\n","        # eliminate lower triangle\n","        for baris in range(1, n):\n","\n","            augmented[baris] = (\n","                r_ij(\n","                    augmented,\n","                    baris,\n","                    0,\n","                    -augmented[baris, 0]\n","                )\n","            ) % 256\n","\n","        # eliminate upper triangle\n","        for kolom in range(1, n):\n","\n","            for baris in range(kolom):\n","\n","                augmented[baris] = (\n","                    r_ij(\n","                        augmented,\n","                        baris,\n","                        kolom,\n","                        -augmented[baris, kolom]\n","                    )\n","                ) % 256\n","\n","        mbalik = augmented[:, n:]\n","\n","        return msa, mbalik\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# AES ENCRYPTION\n","#    ).digest()\n","\n","    cipher = AES.new(\n","        key,\n","        AES.MODE_CBC\n","    )\n","\n","    iv = cipher.iv\n","\n","    padded_data = pad(\n","        data,\n","        AES.block_size\n","    )\n","\n","    ciphertext = cipher.encrypt(\n","        padded_data\n","    )\n","\n","    return list(iv + ciphertext)\n","\n","# key = hashlib.sha256(\n","        kunci.encode()\n","    ).digest()\n","\n","    data = bytes(data)\n","\n","    iv = data[:AES.block_size]\n","\n","    ciphertext = data[AES.block_size:]\n","\n","    cipher = AES.new(\n","        key,\n","        AES.MODE_CBC,\n","        iv=iv\n","    )\n","\n","    decrypted_padded = cipher.decrypt(\n","        ciphertext\n","    )\n","\n","    decrypted = ]\n","\n","    print(f\"\\nAI Matrix Size : {n}\")\n","    print(f\"Hill Length    : {len_hill}\")\n","    print(f\"AES Length     : {len(aes_part)}\")\n","\n","    # ============================================================\n","\n","def load_binary(file_path):\n","\n","    data = np.fromfile(file_path, dtype=np.uint8)\n","\n","    return data\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# ENTROPY ANALYSIS\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def entropy_analysis(data):\n","\n","    histogram = np.bincount(data, minlength=256)\n","\n","    probability = histogram / np.sum(histogram)\n","\n","    probability = probability[probability > 0]\n","\n","    ent = -np.sum(probability * np.log2(probability))\n","\n","    return ent\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# CORRELATION ANALYSIS\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def correlation_analysis(data):\n","\n","    x = data[:-1].astype(np.float64)\n","\n","    y = data[1:].astype(np.float64)\n","\n","    corr, _ = pearsonr(x, y)\n","\n","    return corr\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# AVALANCHE EFFECT\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def avalanche_effect(original, encrypted):\n","\n","    min_len = min(len(original), len(encrypted))\n","\n","    original = original[:min_len]\n","\n","    encrypted = encrypted[:min_len]\n","\n","    diff_bits = 0\n","\n","    total_bits = min_len * 8\n","\n","    for a, b in zip(original, encrypted):\n","\n","        xor = a ^ b\n","\n","        diff_bits += bin(xor).count(\"1\")\n","\n","    avalanche = (diff_bits / total_bits) * 100\n","\n","    return avalanche\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# KEY SENSITIVITY\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def key_sensitivity(cipher1, cipher2):\n","\n","    min_len = min(len(cipher1), len(cipher2))\n","\n","    cipher1 = cipher1[:min_len]\n","\n","    cipher2 = cipher2[:min_len]\n","\n","    different = np.sum(cipher1 != cipher2)\n","\n","    sensitivity = (different / min_len) * 100\n","\n","    return sensitivity\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# CHI-SQUARE TEST\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def chi_square_analysis(data):\n","\n","    histogram = np.bincount(data, minlength=256)\n","\n","    expected = np.ones(256) * (len(data) / 256)\n","\n","    chi_value, p_value = chisquare(histogram, expected)\n","\n","    return chi_value, p_value\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# RANDOMNESS TEST (MONOBIT TEST)\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def randomness_test(data):\n","\n","    bits = np.unpackbits(data)\n","\n","    n = len(bits)\n","\n","    ones = np.sum(bits)\n","\n","    zeros = n - ones\n","\n","    s = abs(ones - zeros) / np.sqrt(n)\n","\n","    p_value = 2 * (1 - norm.cdf(s))\n","\n","    return p_value\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# DIFFERENTIAL ANALYSIS\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def differential_analysis(original, encrypted):\n","\n","    min_len = min(len(original), len(encrypted))\n","\n","    original = original[:min_len]\n","\n","    encrypted = encrypted[:min_len]\n","\n","    diff = np.abs(\n","        original.astype(np.int32)\n","        -\n","        encrypted.astype(np.int32)\n","    )\n","\n","    mean_diff = np.mean(diff)\n","\n","    max_diff = np.max(diff)\n","\n","    return mean_diff, max_diff\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# HISTOGRAM VISUALIZATION\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def show_histogram(original, encrypted):\n","\n","    plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))\n","\n","    plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)\n","\n","    plt.hist(original, bins=256)\n","\n","    plt.title(\"Original File Histogram\")\n","\n","    plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)\n","\n","    plt.hist(encrypted, bins=256)\n","\n","    plt.title(\"Encrypted File Histogram\")\n","\n","    plt.show()\n","\n","# ============================================================\n","# COMPLETE ANALYSIS\n","# ============================================================\n","\n","def complete_analysis(\n","    original_file,\n","    encrypted_file,\n","    encrypted_file_2=None\n","):\n","\n","    print(\"=\" * 70)\n","    print(\"BINARY SECURITY ANALYSIS\")\n","    print(\"=\" * 70)\n","\n","    # load data\n","    original = load_binary(original_file)\n","\n","    encrypted = print(\"\\n[1] ENTROPY ANALYSIS\")\n","\n","    entropy_original = entropy_analysis(original)\n","\n","    entropy_encrypted = entropy_analysis(encrypted)\n","\n","    print(f\"Original Entropy  :  encrypted\n","    )\n","\n","    print(f\"Mean Difference : {mean_diff:.6f}\")\n","\n","    print(f\"Maximum Difference : {max_diff}\")\n","\n","    # ========================================================\n","    # KEY SENSITIVITY\n","    # ========================================================\n","\n","    if encrypted_file_2 is not files.upload()\n","encrypted_file = list(uploaded.keys())[0]\n","\n","print(\"\\nUPLOAD DECRYPTED FILE (OPTIONAL)\")\n","uploaded = files.upload()\n","\n","decrypted_file = None\n","\n","if ==========================================================\n","\n","def md5(fname):\n","\n","    h = hashlib.md5()\n","\n","    with open(fname,\"rb\") as f:\n","\n","        for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(4096),b\"\"):\n","            h.update(chunk)\n","\n","    return h.hexdigest()\n","\n","def sha256(fname):\n","\n","    h = hashlib.sha256()\n","\n","    with open(fname,\"rb\") as f:\n","\n","        for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(4096),b\"\"):\n","            h.update(chunk)\n","\n","    return h.hexdigest()\n","\n","# ==========================================================\n","# ENTROPY\n","# ==========================================================\n","\n","def calc_entropy(data):\n","\n","    hist = np.bincount(data,minlength=256)\n","\n","    prob = hist / np.sum(hist)\n","\n","    return entropy(prob,base=2)\n","\n","# ==========================================================\n","# BYTE CORRELATION\n","# ==========================================================\n","\n","def correlation(data):\n","\n","    x = data[:-1].astype(np.float64)\n","\n","    y = data[1:].astype(np.float64)\n","\n","    return np.corrcoef(x,y)[0,1]\n","\n","# ==========================================================\n","# HAMMING DISTANCE\n","# ==========================================================\n","\n","def hamming_distance(a,b):\n","\n","    n = min(len(a),len(b))\n","\n","    xor = np.bitwise_xor(a[:n],b[:n])\n","\n","    bits = np.unpackbits(xor)\n","\n","    return np.sum(bits)\n","\n","# ==========================================================\n","# BIT CHANGE RATIO\n","# ==========================================================\n","\n","def bit_change_ratio(a,b):\n","\n","    n = min(len(a),len(b))\n","\n","    xor = np.bitwise_xor(a[:n],b[:n])\n","\n","    bits = np.unpackbits(xor)\n","\n","    return np.mean(bits)*100\n","\n","# ==========================================================\n","# MUTUAL INFORMATION\n","# ==========================================================\n","\n","def mutual_information(a,b):\n","\n","    n = min(len(a),len(b))\n","\n","    return mutual_info_score(\n","        a[:n],\n","        b[:n]\n","    )\n","\n","# ==========================================================\n","# COMPRESSION TEST\n","# ==========================================================\n","\n","def zip_size(fname):\n","\n","    tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(\n","        suffix=\".zip\",\n","        delete=False\n","    )\n","\n","    tmp.close()\n","\n","    with zipfile.ZipFile(\n","        tmp.name,\n","        \"w\",\n","        zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED\n","    ) as z:\n","\n","        z.write(fname)\n","\n","    size = os.path.getsize(tmp.name)\n","\n","    os.remove(tmp.name)\n","\n","    return size\n","\n","# ==========================================================\n","# BASIC STATS\n","# ==========================================================\n","\n","entropy_orig = calc_entropy(orig)\n","entropy_enc  = calc_entropy(enc)\n","\n","corr_orig = correlation(orig)\n","corr_enc  = correlation(enc)\n","\n","delta_entropy = entropy_enc - entropy_orig\n","\n","hd = hamming_distance(orig,enc)\n","\n","bcr = bit_change_ratio(orig,enc)\n","\n","mi = mutual_information(orig,enc)\n","\n","# ==========================================================\n","# COMPRESSION RESISTANCE\n","# ==========================================================\n","\n","zip_orig = zip_size(original_file)\n","\n","zip_enc  = zip_size(encrypted_file)\n","\n","comp_orig = (\n","    zip_orig /\n","    os.path.getsize(original_file)\n",")\n","\n","comp_enc = (\n","    zip_enc /\n","    os.path.getsize(encrypted_file)\n",")\n","\n","# ==========================================================\n","# HASH CHECK\n","# ==========================================================\n","\n","if decrypted_file:\n","\n","    integrity = (\n","        md5(original_file)\n","        ==\n","        md5(decrypted_file)\n","    )\n","\n","else:\n","\n","    integrity = \"N/A\"\n","\n","# ==========================================================\n","# RESULT TABLE\n","# ==========================================================\n","\n","results = pd.DataFrame({\n","\n","    \"Metric\":[\n","\n","        \"Entropy Original\",\n","        \"Entropy Cipher\",\n","\n","        \"Entropy Growth\",\n","\n","        \"Correlation Original\",\n","        \"Correlation Cipher\",\n","\n","        \"Hamming Distance\",\n","\n","        \"Bit Change Ratio (%)\",\n","\n","        \"Mutual Information\",\n","\n","        \"Compression Ratio Original\",\n","        \"Compression Ratio Cipher\",\n","\n","        \"MD5 Integrity\"\n","\n","    ],\n","\n","    \"Value\":[\n","\n","        entropy_orig,\n","        entropy_enc,\n","\n","        delta_entropy,\n","\n","        corr_orig,\n","        corr_enc,\n","\n","        hd,\n","\n","        bcr,\n","\n","        mi,\n","\n","        comp_orig,\n","        comp_enc,\n","\n","        integrity\n","\n","    ]\n","\n","})\n","\n","print(\"\\n\")\n","print(\"=\"*80)\n","print(\"SECURITY ANALYSIS RESULTS\")\n","print(\"=\"*80)\n","\n","display(results)\n","\n","# ==========================================================\n","# BYTE HISTOGRAM\n","# ==========================================================\n","\n","plt.figure(figsize=(12,5))\n","\n","plt.hist(\n","    orig,\n","    bins=256,\n","    alpha=0.5,\n","    label=\"Original\"\n",")\n","\n","plt.hist(\n","    enc,\n","    bins=256,\n","    alpha=0.5,\n","    label=\"Encrypted\"\n",")\n","\n","plt.legend()\n","\n","plt.title(\"Byte Frequency Distribution\")\n","\n","plt.show()\n","\n","# ==========================================================\n","# CORRELATION SCATTER\n","# inputElement.addEventListener('change', (e) => {\n","      resolve(e.target.files);\n","    });\n","  });\n","\n","  const cancel = document.createElement('button');\n","  inputElement.parentElement.appendChild(cancel);\n","  cancel.textContent = 'Cancel upload';\n","  const cancelPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n","    cancel.onclick = () => {\n","      resolve(null);\n","    };\n","  });\n","\n","  // Wait for the user to pick the files.\n","  const files = yield {\n","    promise: Promise.race([pickedPromise, cancelPromise]),\n","    response:
